facts.fact: The state news agency reports that loi n°15/2014 of 7 January 2015 instituting and organising the national statistical system, as modified by loi n°016/2022 of 6 September 2022, is the legislation currently in force.
facts.system: Loi n°15/2014 du 7 janvier 2015 instituant et organisant le Système statistique national (2015)

facts.fact: The Minister of Planning and Prospective presented to the Council of Ministers on 22 May 2026 a bill amending ten articles of the statistics law (articles 2, 8, 9, 10, 12, 17, 22, 26, 27 and 35) to conform it to the Constitution of 19 December 2024; it was a bill before cabinet, not enacted.
facts.system: Projet de loi portant modification de certaines dispositions de la loi n°15/2014 instituant et organisant le Système statistique national (2026)

systems.owner: Ministère de la Planification et de la Prospective
